headline: Interior Minister Puts Friday Detentions at 1,747
deck: France's interior minister put Friday detentions at 1,747 and this week's above 5,000, calling the unrest a slide into urban violence.
body: Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez told TF1 late Friday that **1,747** people were detained that day and **1,954** on Thursday, with more than **5,000** held since Monday during protests by French students. [E5][E3][E2]
He put schools affected on Friday at **735**, 30% fewer than the previous day. [E6]

Riot police clashed with protesters as thousands of students demonstrated. [E1] "We are sliding into riot and urban violence, and we are using all intermediate means to put an end to it," Nuñez said. [E4]
